front.title: AI Agent Architecture for Network Digital Twin

abstract.t:
This document proposes an AI agent architecture for Network Digital Twin (NDT) that enables collaborative reasoning, simulation-assisted decision-making, and closed-loop network operations.
The architecture integrates specialized AI agents into the core NDT components and introduces mechanisms for twin validity assessment, evidence-based decision-making, and policy-controlled execution.
It further describes multi-agent coordination, simulation evidence exchange, and feedback-driven model evolution to improve the reliability and adaptability of AI-assisted network management.
The document also identifies research challenges and potential interoperability requirements for integrating AI agents with NDT- based network management systems.
